name: Getting Started Template/create_event_log
description: Creates a record in the event log table

input.name: user_id
input.description: Unique identifier for the user who performed the action.

input.name: account_id
input.description: Unique identifier for the account associated with the event.

input.name: action
input.description: A description of the action performed by the user (e.g., 'login', 'created_invoice').

input.name: metadata
input.description: Additional data related to the event, such as resource IDs or old/new values.
